requirements.description: Profile initialization creates the required private scaffold, preserves existing owner files, validates JSONC before mutation, canonicalizes aliases, converges under covered races, and installs distinct embedded Voices. Cross-process valid races, create-operation cleanup, and permission denial remain explicitly unclaimed.

Deterministic Provider/auth contracts cover strict Profile configuration, daemon-owned bounded credentials, model resolution, filesystem Session runtime construction, negotiated fake API-key/OAuth boundaries, compiled OAuth loading, and secret-safe evidence.

Profile lock, Provider/auth composition, Session runtime factory, daemon kernel, attach server, interruption, and ordered finalization are scoped Effect resources with external Promise APIs isolated at named boundaries.

Attach v2 reserves main, daemon-owned session/ensure lazily creates it exactly once under concurrent real-socket Clients, and the durable Session survives daemon restart without a second existence authority.
A disposable Anthropic Profile completed the production hidden-TTY API-key login, persisted a private schema-v1 credential, and passed doctor without exposing credential material.

A fresh disposable Profile completed Ziggy's compiled production openai-codex browser OAuth flow without importing existing credential bytes, persisted a private schema-v1 refresh-capable credential, passed doctor, and returned an exact real gpt-5.6-luna response.
After the live API-key login and Codex OAuth import, doctor reported real Provider authentication state without exposing credential material.
A real authenticated openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna ask ensured main, returned exit 0, streamed only ZIGGY LUNA LIVE with exactly one final newline, and emitted empty stderr.
The live Provider Turn persisted mode-0600 sessions/main.ndjson with schema-v1 contiguous envelopes, the configured Provider/model, and a completed terminal event.
A scripted Provider ask over the production Attach Client ensures main, emits only accepted Turn text with one final newline, persists exactly one complete Turn, and does not duplicate Provider work.

A compiled ask against a stopped disposable Profile crosses production probe, detached spawn, readiness handshake, and original-intent retry exactly once before the first Turn write; a barrier-controlled absent-to-stale race refuses startup.
A production attach-server fault after durable Turn acceptance drops the correlated response and proves exit 3, one turn-started event, one Provider call, and no resend or reconnect write.
Two Sessions run concurrent scripted Turns over separate real-socket Clients without cross-Session blocking.
A resume cursor beyond the durable tail is rejected and cannot later receive envelopes below its requested sequence.
Native launchd lifecycle is proven on this Darwin host; Linux systemd behavior is explicitly unavailable on host while deterministic unit contracts remain covered.

Deterministic controlled Providers drive ZiggyTuiComponent through the production interpreter and shared Attach Client over real Unix sockets, proving main resume, token streaming, steer, exactly-once queued follow-up, active-Turn interrupt, local-first and remote-first approval resolution, A-to-B-to-A subscription replacement with stale callback rejection, disconnect without Turn cancellation, last-applied-cursor replay/live overlap without duplication, blocked retry mutations, outcome-unknown composer retention, and quit/Ctrl+C Client cleanup without daemon interruption. Supporting interpreter contracts prove bounded serialized command execution, exact Attach calls, overload reporting, generation-safe callbacks, idempotent cleanup, and cleanup-failure propagation.

A real Luna-high terminal journey proved stable-main streaming, durable steering, one queued follow-up, interruption, Ctrl+P Session picker and Escape behavior, detach, fresh replay of 883 envelopes, and reconnect from retained cursor 883 after four attempts without visible duplication. Approval and multi-Session replacement remain covered by the deterministic production-path scenario rather than this manual journey.

The pure TUI projection keys output by Turn and Step, retains pending approvals independently of overlay visibility, gates mutation intents to live subscriptions, rejects stale resume generations, and renders state-correct controls and centered Session pickers.
Deterministic package-graph evidence proves packages/tui depends only on packages/protocol and its pinned terminal dependency, never core or ziggy; hosted CI remains disabled.
Real daemon operations create all listed Sessions, main is created only through session/ensure, and a real-socket empty-Profile list returns [] without creating sessions/main.ndjson.

Compiled processes prove exits 0, 1, 2, 3, and SIGINT 130 with exact stdout/newline behavior, bounded stderr, transport finalization, one durable Turn, deterministic stale-socket refusal, cleanup, and no daemon Turn interruption.

Every landed deterministic Face scenario is registered with exactly one bounded schema-valid observation marker; findings-bearing verify:s3 and verify:all pass with the final consolidated resolved review findings.
